summary: As of mid-to-late 2026, ChatGPT/GPT models retain dominant consumer mindshare with 55.5% of generative AI web traffic, but the enterprise API landscape is more fragmented, with Anthropic leading enterprise API usage at 40% share, OpenAI at 27%, and Google at 21%. Open-weight models like Llama 4 and DeepSeek-V3 have surged on HuggingFace and self-hosted deployments, while Claude and Gemini have seen explosive year-over-year growth of 855% and 450% respectively in web visits. Developer adoption data from OpenRouter shows DeepSeek commanding 24.4% of text API requests, underscoring the rise of cost-efficient open and open-weight alternatives.

models.name: GPT-5 / GPT-5.1
models.popularity_notes: ChatGPT holds 55.5% of worldwide generative AI web visits as of August 2026 (Similarweb), and OpenAI leads the LLM API provider market with GPT-5 and GPT-5.1 serving both consumer and enterprise deployments.
strengths: Largest installed developer base globally
Broad ecosystem of plugins and integrations
Strong general-purpose reasoning and instruction following
Extensive enterprise support and SLAs
Wide third-party tooling and framework support
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise applications, consumer-facing chatbots, and developers seeking the widest ecosystem compatibility

models.name: Claude Opus 5 / Claude Fable 5.1
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic leads enterprise API usage at 40% share (Menlo Ventures 2025), claude.ai recorded 952.6 million web visits in May 2026 (855% YoY growth), and Claude Fable 5.1 tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 66 as of September 2026.
strengths: Top-ranked on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index as of September 2026
Leads enterprise API adoption at 40% market share
Exceptional long-context document analysis
Strong safety and alignment properties
Superior coding and complex reasoning benchmarks
models.best_for: Enterprise API workloads, complex document analysis, coding assistance, and safety-critical applications

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Gemini web visits surged to 2.9 billion in May 2026 (450% YoY growth, Similarweb), capturing 25.6% of generative AI web traffic in August 2026, and Google holds 21% of enterprise API usage.
strengths: Largest context window among leading proprietary models at 1M tokens
Deep integration with Google Workspace and Cloud
Fastest-growing consumer AI platform in 2026
Strong multimodal capabilities
Competitive pricing relative to peers
models.best_for: Long-document processing, Google Cloud-integrated enterprise workflows, and multimodal applications

models.name: DeepSeek-V3
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek models accounted for 24.4% of all text API requests on OpenRouter in the week of September 21, 2026, making it the dominant open-weight model by API call volume on the largest model-switching marketplace.
strengths: Dominant on OpenRouter with 24.4% of text API requests
Extremely competitive pricing as open-weight model
Strong coding and reasoning performance relative to cost
Self-hostable for on-premise enterprise deployments
Rapidly growing developer community
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive API workloads, self-hosted deployments, and developers seeking high performance at minimal inference cost

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Llama 4 is consistently ranked among the top open-weight alternatives for self-hosted and on-premise deployment, with Meta's Llama family historically dominating HuggingFace download leaderboards across developer surveys.
strengths: Most downloaded open-weight model family on HuggingFace
Zero licensing cost for self-hosted deployment
Strong community fine-tuning ecosystem
Flexible deployment across cloud and on-premise
Backed by Meta's research and infrastructure
models.best_for: Self-hosted enterprise deployments, fine-tuning for domain-specific applications, and cost-free open-source development

models.name: Grok-3 / Grok-4
models.popularity_notes: Grok holds 2.4% of generative AI web traffic as of August 2026 (Similarweb), and GPT-6 Astra/Grok-4 leads on hardest math, reasoning, and cyber benchmarks per Artificial Analysis data, with 2M token context window noted on OpenRouter.
strengths: Largest context window at 2M tokens eliminating chunking for large documents
Leads on hard math, reasoning, and cybersecurity benchmarks
Real-time data access via X platform integration
Rapid model iteration cadence
Strong performance on agentic and long-context tasks
models.best_for: Advanced reasoning tasks, long-context document analysis, real-time information retrieval, and cybersecurity applications

models.name: Qwen3 (Qwen family)
models.popularity_notes: The Qwen family has been adopted by over 90,000 enterprises across consumer electronics, gaming, and other sectors, making it the leading LLM by enterprise deployment count outside of US providers.
strengths: Over 90,000 enterprise adoptions globally
Strong multilingual capabilities especially in Chinese
Open-weight availability for self-hosted deployment
Broad sector coverage including consumer electronics and gaming
Competitive performance-to-cost ratio
models.best_for: Enterprise deployments in Asia-Pacific, multilingual applications, and organizations requiring open-weight self-hosted solutions

models.name: Microsoft Copilot (GPT-based)
models.popularity_notes: Microsoft Copilot holds 1.6% of generative AI web traffic as of August 2026 (Similarweb), underpinned by deep integration across Microsoft 365 and Azure, driving substantial enterprise developer adoption via existing software agreements.
strengths: Deep integration with Microsoft 365, Azure, and GitHub
Bundled into existing enterprise Microsoft agreements
Strong IDE integration via GitHub Copilot for developers
Enterprise security and compliance features
Large pre-existing enterprise customer base
models.best_for: Microsoft-ecosystem enterprises, developer productivity via GitHub Copilot, and organizations already invested in Azure infrastructure

models.name: Mistral Small 4
models.popularity_notes: Mistral Small 4 (119B total / 6.5B active MoE, Apache 2.0, March 2026) is priced at $0.15 input / $0.60 output per 1M tokens and consolidates instruct, reasoning, and coding in a single model, making it a top choice for cost-sensitive developer workloads.
strengths: Apache 2.0 license enabling fully open commercial use
Best-in-class price efficiency at $0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens
256K context window in a cost-optimized model
Combined instruct, reasoning, and coding capabilities
Strong European regulatory compliance posture
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive developer workloads, high-throughput API applications, and organizations requiring open-licensed models for commercial use

models.name: Perplexity Sonar
models.popularity_notes: Perplexity holds 0.9% of generative AI web traffic as of August 2026 (Similarweb), and its Sonar API has gained traction among developers building search-augmented and real-time retrieval applications.
strengths: Built-in real-time web search and retrieval augmentation
Cited sources in responses enabling verifiable outputs
Developer API purpose-built for search-augmented generation
Lower hallucination rate on current-events queries
Competitive pricing for retrieval-augmented workloads
models.best_for: Search-augmented generation, real-time information retrieval applications, and developers building fact-grounded AI products
